posts.title: Three Days With Boyd's Station
posts.excerpt: A June 2025 photo essay from Cynthiana, Ky., documents community life around Boyd's Station, an arts and journalism residency project in Harrison County.
posts.leadImageAlt: Musicians perform at the Aeolian Music Hall in Cynthiana, Ky., beneath a glowing red neon sign, June 12, 2025.
